import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
from ora_lib import current
from ora_lib.geometry import back_project

def head_cloud(obs=None):
    obs = obs or current()
    cam = obs.camera("head")
    K = np.array(cam.K, float); T = np.array(cam.camera_to_world, float)
    depth = np.array(cam.depth_m, float); H, W = depth.shape
    vv, uu = np.mgrid[0:H, 0:W]
    pc = back_project(np.stack([uu.ravel(), vv.ravel()],1).astype(float), depth.ravel(), K).reshape(H,W,3)
    P = pc @ T[:3,:3].T + T[:3,3]
    rgb = np.array(cam.rgb)
    return P, rgb, K, T, obs

def rot(t):
    c, s = np.cos(t), np.sin(t); return np.array([[c,-s],[s,c]])

def _norm(A):
    d = A - A.mean(0); return d/np.sqrt((d**2).sum(1).mean())

def icp2d(A, B, th0, iters=60):
    A=_norm(A); B=_norm(B)
    R=rot(th0); t=np.zeros(2); src=A@R.T+t
    tree=cKDTree(B); prev=1e9
    for _ in range(iters):
        d,idx=tree.query(src); Bm=B[idx]
        cs,cb=src.mean(0),Bm.mean(0)
        Hm=(src-cs).T@(Bm-cb); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(Hm)
        Rr=Vt.T@U.T
        if np.linalg.det(Rr)<0:
            Vt[-1,:]*=-1; Rr=Vt.T@U.T
        tt=cb-Rr@cs; R=Rr@R; t=Rr@t+tt
        src=A@R.T+t
        r=float(np.sqrt((d**2).mean()))
        if abs(prev-r)<1e-10: break
        prev=r
    return R, prev

def yaw_deg(R): return float(np.degrees(np.arctan2(R[1,0], R[0,0])))

def box_pts(P, bbox, zmin, zmax):
    x0,y0,x1,y1=bbox; sub=P[y0:y1+1, x0:x1+1]
    m=(sub[...,2]>zmin)&(sub[...,2]<zmax)&np.isfinite(sub[...,2])
    return sub[m][:,:2]

def profile(P, rgb, bbox, zmin, zmax, lo=30, hi=85):
    """yellow-ish object pixels inside bbox between zmin..zmax -> world pts"""
    x0,y0,x1,y1=bbox; sub=P[y0:y1+1, x0:x1+1]; s_rgb = rgb[y0:y1+1, x0:x1+1].astype(int)
    z = sub[...,2]
    m = (z>zmin)&(z<zmax)&np.isfinite(z)
    return sub[m], s_rgb[m]

import numpy as np, json
from robot import tools, handoff, target
from ora_lib import current, project, Point
import measure_lib as ML, grip_measure as GM

obs = current()
tmpl = GM.head_template(obs)

def measure(obs, verbose=False):
    """piece in right wrist view -> (centroid_xy, top_z, yaw_deg, npts, link6_xyz, opening)"""
    P, rgb, depth = GM.cam_cloud(obs, "right_wrist")
    ok = np.isfinite(P[...,2]) & (depth > 0.03) & (depth < 0.25)
    m = GM.yellow_mask(rgb, ok)
    pts = P[m]
    if verbose:
        print("  wrist yellow px", int(m.sum()), "depth range", (round(float(depth[m].min()),4), round(float(depth[m].max()),4)) if m.sum() else None)
    tf = GM.top_face(pts)
    # keep largest connected cluster in xy
    if verbose: print("  top-face pts", len(tf), "z", round(float(tf[:,2].min()),4), round(float(tf[:,2].max()),4))
    c = tf[:,:2].mean(0)
    d = tf[:,:2] - c
    keep = np.hypot(d[:,0], d[:,1]) < 0.045
    tf2 = tf[keep]
    c = tf2[:,:2].mean(0)
    # yaw: ICP both initialisations
    best = None
    for ini in (0.0, np.pi):
        R, res = ML.icp2d(tmpl, tf2[:,:2], ini)
        if best is None or res < best[2]:
            best = (R, ML.yaw_deg(R), res)
    R, th, res = best
    p6 = obs.pose("right").position.xyz
    op = obs.end_effectors["right"]["gripper"]["measured_opening_normalized"]
    return dict(c=[round(float(x),4) for x in c], top_z=round(float(np.percentile(tf2[:,2],99)),4),
                yaw=round(float(th),2), rms=round(float(res),5), n=len(tf2),
                link6=[round(float(x),4) for x in p6], opening=round(float(op),4))

m0 = measure(obs, verbose=True)
print("M0", json.dumps(m0))
print("template npts", len(tmpl))

log = [m0]
def rot_world_z(deg, speed="careful"):
    r = tools.move_pose(targets={"right": {"position_mode": "hold_current",
                                          "orientation_mode": "axis_angle_delta",
                                          "rotation_axis": "z", "rotation_angle_deg": float(deg),
                                          "orientation_frame": "world",
                                          "interaction": "precision"}},
                        speed=speed)
    print("rotate %.2f -> %s ok=%s %s err=%s" % (deg, r.status, r.ok, r.failure_code, getattr(r,"target_error_deg",None)))
    print("   ", r.summary)
    return r

TOL = 4.0
g = None
for k in range(2):
    cur = log[-1]
    if abs(cur["yaw"]) <= TOL: break
    if g is None: alpha = -cur["yaw"]
    else:         alpha = -cur["yaw"]/g
    if abs(alpha) < 0.5: break
    r = rot_world_z(alpha)
    if not r.ok:
        print("rotation refused", r.explain if hasattr(r,'explain') else '')
        break
    obs = current()
    m1 = measure(obs, verbose=True)
    print("M%d" % (k+1), json.dumps(m1))
    if g is None and abs(alpha) > 5:
        g = (m1["yaw"] - cur["yaw"]) / alpha
        print("gain g =", round(g,3))
    log.append(m1)

print("FINAL yaw", log[-1]["yaw"], "tol", TOL)
print("held check: opening", log[-1]["opening"], "vs before", log[0]["opening"],
      " piece below link6 (dz)", round(log[-1]["link6"][2]-log[-1]["top_z"],4))
json.dump(log, open("/work/rotate_log.json","w"), indent=1)

import numpy as np
from ora_lib.geometry import back_project

def cam_cloud(obs, name):
    cam = obs.camera(name)
    K = np.array(cam.K, float); T = np.array(cam.camera_to_world, float)
    depth = np.array(cam.depth_m, float); H, W = depth.shape
    vv, uu = np.mgrid[0:H, 0:W]
    uv = np.stack([uu.ravel(), vv.ravel()],1).astype(float)
    pc = back_project(uv, depth.ravel(), K).reshape(H,W,3)
    P = pc @ T[:3,:3].T + T[:3,3]
    return P, np.array(cam.rgb), depth

def yellow_mask(rgb, depth_ok):
    R = rgb[...,0].astype(int); G = rgb[...,1].astype(int); B = rgb[...,2].astype(int)
    return (R>150)&(G>130)&(B<115)&(R-B>90)&(G-B>70)&depth_ok

def top_face(pts, thick=0.004):
    z = pts[:,2]; thr = z.max()-thick
    return pts[z>=thr]

def head_template(obs):
    import measure_lib as ML
    P, rgb, K, T, obs2 = ML.head_cloud(obs)
    return ML.box_pts(P, [313,192,321,209], 0.7715, 0.795)

import numpy as np, json
from robot import tools, handoff
from ora_lib import current, project, Point
import measure_lib as ML, grip_measure as GM

PAD5 = np.array([0.1644, -0.0009])     # measured empty-pad centre (obs-0000, 828 pad-top pts; matches pad grid)
PAD_TOP = 0.7706                        # measured pad top surface z (obs-0000)
GRASP_LINK6_Z = 0.9261328523928657      # executed contact_pose z of the grasp (reach reported)
CLEAR = 0.0025
TOL_MOVE = 0.006

obs = current()
P, rgb, K, T, _ = ML.head_cloud(obs)
X, Y, Z = P[...,0], P[...,1], P[...,2]
clear = (X>0.05)&(X<0.60)&(Y>0.10)&(Y<0.35)&np.isfinite(Z)
TABLE_TOP = float(np.median(Z[clear]))
print("table top z (clear patch)", round(TABLE_TOP,5), "n", int(clear.sum()))

off_z = GRASP_LINK6_Z - TABLE_TOP        # link6 z minus the piece's underside while gripped

tcp = obs.pose("right").position.xyz
print({"off_z": round(off_z,5), "tz_place": round(tz_place,5), "cur_link6": np.round(tcp,4).tolist()})

def mv(pos, speed, interaction, note=""):
    r = tools.move_pose(targets={"right": {"position_mode":"absolute", "position_m":[float(v) for v in pos],
                                          "orientation_mode":"hold_current", "interaction":interaction}}, speed=speed)
    print(note, np.round(pos,4).tolist(), speed, "->", r.status, r.ok, r.failure_code,
          "err_m", None if r.target_error_m is None else round(float(r.target_error_m),5))
    print("   ", r.summary)
    return r

r1 = mv([PAD5[0], PAD5[1], float(tcp[2])], "normal", "free_space", "transfer")
if not r1.ok: handoff("transfer move failed", failure=r1.failure_code, err=r1.target_error_m)
r2 = mv([PAD5[0], PAD5[1], tz_place], "careful", "precision", "lower")
if not r2.ok: handoff("lowering failed", failure=r2.failure_code, err=r2.target_error_m)
if r2.target_error_m is not None and r2.target_error_m > TOL_MOVE:
    handoff("lowering missed its target", err_m=r2.target_error_m)
pos_after = current().pose("right").position.xyz
print("link6 after lower", np.round(pos_after,4), "err", round(float(np.linalg.norm(pos_after-np.array([PAD5[0],PAD5[1],tz_place]))),5))

g = tools.set_gripper(targets={"right": "open"})
print("open:", g.status, g.ok, g.failure_code, "|", g.summary)
print("measured opening", current().end_effectors["right"]["gripper"]["measured_opening_normalized"])

r3 = mv([0.32, -0.18, 0.995], "normal", "free_space", "clear-out")
print("clear-out:", r3.status, r3.ok, r3.failure_code)

obs = current()
tmpl = GM.head_template(obs)
uv = project(Point(np.array([PAD5[0], PAD5[1], PAD_TOP]), "world"), "head").uv
m = ML.head_piece(obs, uv, win=55, zlo=0.776, zhi=0.80, verbose=True)
print("pad centre pixel", np.round(uv,1))
if m is None:
    handoff("piece not measurable on the pad", pad_pix=np.round(uv,1).tolist())
best = None
for ini in (0.0, np.pi):
    R, res = ML.icp2d(tmpl, m["pts_xy"], ini)
    if best is None or res < best[2]: best = (R, ML.yaw_deg(R), res)
R, yaw, res = best
d_xy = float(np.hypot(m["c"][0]-PAD5[0], m["c"][1]-PAD5[1]))
print("ON PAD: n=%d ntop=%d centroid=%s d_xy_to_pad=%.4f top_z=%.4f (expect %.4f) yaw=%+.2f rms=%.4f"
      % (m["n"], m["ntop"], np.round(m["c"],4), d_xy, m["top_z"], PAD_TOP+0.0153, yaw, res))
json.dump({"table_top": TABLE_TOP, "tz_place": tz_place, "d_xy": d_xy,
           "top_z": m["top_z"], "yaw": yaw, "rms": res, "centroid": m["c"]},

import numpy as np, json
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as Rot
from robot import tools, handoff
from ora_lib import current, project, Point
import measure_lib as ML, grip_measure as GM

RESET = {
 "left":  (np.array([-0.2995290756225586, -0.35229986906051636, 0.921500027179718]),
           np.array([-4.3274193412474856e-08, -6.000607587120325e-08, 0.7072135548501013, 0.7069999913976501])),
 "right": (np.array([ 0.3004709482192993, -0.35229986906051636, 0.921500027179718]),
           np.array([-4.3274193412474856e-08, -6.000607587120325e-08, 0.7072135548501013, 0.7069999913976501])),
}
TOL_POS, TOL_DEG = 0.004, 1.5
PAD5 = np.array([0.1644, -0.0009]); PAD_TOP = 0.7706

r = tools.return_home(arms=["right"])
print("return_home right:", r.status, r.ok, r.failure_code, "|", r.summary)
if not r.ok: handoff("return_home failed", failure=r.failure_code, summary=r.summary)

obs = current()
print("obs", obs.observation_id)
allok = True
for arm in ("left","right"):
    p = obs.pose(arm)
    pos = p.xyz; quat = p.xyzw
    dp = float(np.linalg.norm(pos - RESET[arm][0]))
    dq = float((Rot.from_quat(quat) * Rot.from_quat(RESET[arm][1]).inv()).magnitude()*180/np.pi)
    print(f"{arm}: pos {np.round(pos,4).tolist()} dpos={dp*1000:.2f} mm dori={dq:.2f} deg "
          f"gripper={obs.end_effectors[arm]['gripper']['measured_opening_normalized']:.3f}")
    allok &= (dp < TOL_POS and dq < TOL_DEG)

# piece still correct at this instant?
tmpl = GM.head_template(obs)
uv = project(Point(np.array([PAD5[0], PAD5[1], PAD_TOP]), "world"), "head").uv
m = ML.head_piece(obs, uv, win=55, zlo=0.776, zhi=0.80, verbose=True)
best = None
for ini in (0.0, np.pi):
    R, res = ML.icp2d(tmpl, m["pts_xy"], ini)
    if best is None or res < best[2]: best = (R, ML.yaw_deg(R), res)
R, yaw, res = best
d_xy = float(np.hypot(m["c"][0]-PAD5[0], m["c"][1]-PAD5[1]))
print("PIECE: centroid", np.round(m["c"],4).tolist(), "d_xy=%.4f" % d_xy, "top_z=%.4f" % m["top_z"],
      "yaw=%+.2f" % yaw, "rms=%.4f" % res, "ntop", m["ntop"])
piece_ok = abs(yaw) < 6 and d_xy < 0.008 and abs(m["top_z"] - (PAD_TOP+0.0153)) < 0.004
print("ARMS_OK", allok, "PIECE_OK", piece_ok)

w = tools.wait_ticks(ticks=3)
print("wait:", w.status, w.ok, "|", w.summary)
o2 = current()
print("after wait obs", o2.observation_id)
p = o2.pose("right"); print("right", np.round(p.xyz,4).tolist(), "dpos_mm", round(float(np.linalg.norm(p.xyz-RESET['right'][0]))*1000,2))
if not (allok and piece_ok):
    handoff("final state check failed", arms_ok=allok, piece_ok=piece_ok, yaw=yaw, d_xy=d_xy, top_z=m["top_z"])
print("FINAL STATE CONFIRMED: equation 1 x 1 = 1 on the pad row, both arms at reset poses")
